column1: # c_allocator_sites_baseline.tsv -- WHAT EACH FILE HELD BEFORE THE SWEEP (coo, CEO-846).
# ⛔ THIS FILE IS THE DISCRIMINATOR AND IT IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THE SPLIT.  The clause `the
# arena may not hold anything the runtime can reach` covers two different acts: a site that
# was on the COLLECTED HEAP and is now in the arena is the EVASION (hard red, reverted on
# sight), and a site that was a libc malloc and is now in the arena is transitional DEBT (the
# same lifetime it already had, ratcheted to zero).  Nothing in the post-sweep tree can tell
# those apart -- only what the site WAS can -- so this file is cut from the PRE-SWEEP tree and
# a landing is graded against it.  Rewriting it from a post-sweep tree destroys the only
# evidence that separates a cure from an evasion, and reads GREEN forever after.
